scope: One discovery pass; added candidate 4 is ordinary public post-deployment price correction, not sniping or front-running.

coverage.note: Continuation chunks, an obsolete paper revision, navigation pages and a 404 consume fetch calls but do not count as independent research evidence. The first three candidate-specific documents used the remaining base allowance; only the six calls after call 20 used the expanded allowance. The extension was authorized for candidate 4 only.

reading_method.method: Read extracted full text, including references and appendices, for the four priority works. Retrieved continuation chunks where necessary. Distinguish reading from fetching throughout.
reading_method.limitations: PDF extraction garbles some equations, figures and tables. No PDF figure was digitized or independently reproduced. Full-text reading does not mean every displayed mathematical formula was visually verified.
reading_method.hashes: Hashes below cover assembled UTF-8 extracted markdown, not publisher PDF bytes. Assembled chunks retain extraction boundary markers. Copyrighted bulk source text is not included in this package.
reading_method.returns: Paper-reported examples, theoretical opportunities and provider deployment claims are not independently reconciled operator net returns.

assigned.title: Uniswap v2 Core
assigned.triage: Relevant backward mechanism reference. Arbitrary pairs change routing costs; flash swaps require repayment within the same atomic transaction. Not a cross-chain flash-loan deployment.
assigned.exclusions: Oracle-manipulation examples are risk context only; no attack construction or reproduction.

assigned.title: Top Decentralized Exchanges Ranked by Volume | CoinGecko
assigned.triage: A venue-discovery directory, not evidence of a particular new deployment, tradable pool, entrant capture or net returns. No current ranking or volume claim was adopted.

assigned.title: Frontrunner Jones and the Raiders of the Dark Forest: An Empirical Study of Frontrunning on the Ethereum Blockchain
assigned.triage: Attack-focused historical context. Excluded from strategy origination and operational testing. Search discovery is not a completed paper read.

assigned.title: Cross-Rollup MEV: Non-Atomic Arbitrage Across L2 Blockchains
assigned.triage: Potential cross-rollup and DEX-CEX arbitrage, episode-level de-duplication, inventory and liquidity constraints. Maximum arbitrage value is not an executed complete-cycle return.
caveats: The initially fetched v1 has a different title and was partial; it is neither a fifth priority source nor an independent replication.
Episode peak selection is ex post; it cannot be treated as a causal online capture rule.
CEX depth/price-impact and execution assumptions do not establish full all-in net profit.
Shared-sequencing/instant-bridging discussion is not proof of a deployed permissionless cross-chain flash loan.
Market structure and auction statements describe the historical study, not verified 2026 conditions.

assigned.title: An Empirical Study of Cross-chain Arbitrage in Decentralized Exchanges
assigned.conference_metadata: COMSNETS 2024; exact publication/revision day not verified.
assigned.triage: BNB/PancakeSwap and Polygon/QuickSwap pool-state opportunities and cycle accounting. Authors explicitly do not identify the trades users actually executed.
caveats: The model joins same-token representations across chains without a complete bridge/rebalancing/collateral ledger.
Gas is estimated, not the complete realized cycle cost.
Multiple paths and overlapping pools cannot simply be added as independent profits.
Equation/table extraction is degraded; no precise formula or table amount was independently reproduced.
The inventory lists Mazor and Rottenstreich; extracted front matter appears incomplete. No authorship correction is inferred from that extraction.

assigned.title: SoK: Cross-Domain MEV
assigned.triage: Separates cross-domain protocol classes and actual implementations from ideal functionality; distinguishes time and intrinsic optionality. A privileged extractor action space is not ordinary entrant access.
caveats: A survey/proposal taxonomy, not an operator return ledger.
2023 descriptions of deployments, sequencers, auctions and RFQ access require fresh verification.
Shared ordering is not atomic bridging or free collateral.
Attack classes and ordering manipulation are context only, excluded from the mechanisms here.

assigned.title: Unity is Strength: A Formalization of Cross-Domain Maximal Extractable Value
assigned.triage: Inventory pre-positioning and later rebalancing were already explicit in section 3.1 in 2021. Cross-domain valuation requires an explicit conversion model.
caveats: Formal maximum extractable value and illustrative AMMs are not observed attainable operator returns.
The paper explicitly leaves bridge/oracle trust and probabilistic CEX interactions as open modeling questions.
Sequencer collusion and reorganization attacks are risk context only, not proposed methods.

assigned.title: OmniCat
assigned.triage: Current project-linked chain/contract identities and eight-chain claim. Undated homepage metrics and unavailable chart data are not current pool-depth, TVL or return evidence.
assigned.caveats: OmniCat OMNI is not Omni Network OMNI. Present identity links do not prove historical peer configuration, taxes, available transfers, depth or redemption.

assigned.title: Fork-Choice enforced Inclusion Lists (FOCIL): A simple committee-based inclusion list proposal
assigned.triage: Censorship-resistance/inclusion-list proposal; not an ordinary price-correction income mechanism. No claim about current activation was adopted.
assigned.bibliography_note: Source byline includes Barnabe as well as Thomas, Francesco and Julian; the inventory's shorter author list should not be treated as independently verified.

assigned.title: ZKsync Docs
assigned.triage: General portal, not a specific instrument, deployment event or atomic-bridging proof. No present deployment or profit inference was adopted.

supplemental.title: Cross-Chain Arbitrage: The Next Frontier of MEV in Decentralized Finance
supplemental.relevance: Historical OmniCat/tBTC deployment episodes, inventory-first and bridge-first examples, and collateralized Aave inventory replacement. Later publication indexing does not refresh the empirical window.

supplemental.title: Short Paper: Atomic Execution is Not Enough for Arbitrage Profit Extraction in Shared Sequencers
supplemental.relevance: Newer related reading. Explicitly distinguishes atomic execution from atomic bridging; shows model-dependent valuation/failure tradeoffs. Assumes independent failures and omits transaction costs; not a reason to seek failed trades or proof of real profits.

supplemental.title: Circle Gateway Now Supports cirBTC and EURC
supplemental.relevance: Current-window new transfer capability for existing assets. Native issuer minting is not cross-asset conversion, atomic arbitrage or absence of issuer/custody risk.
supplemental.caveats: Sub-500ms access is after deposit finalization; outside-Arc advertised component fee is 1bp for EURC/cirBTC, not an all-in quote. Permissionless withdrawal has a seven-day delay. Generic USDC-only boilerplate conflicts with the expanded-asset body; consult current asset-specific documentation and terms.

supplemental.title: Circle Gateway: New Pre-Mint Address for EURC on Solana
supplemental.relevance: A dated non-EVM operational change, not a new public token mint or proof of tradable inventory.
supplemental.safety: The published address is a pre-mint staging account, not a user deposit address. Never send funds to it. Pre-minted balance is not circulating supply or pool liquidity.

supplemental.title: Gateway supported blockchains
supplemental.relevance: Current asset/chain matrix and confirmation requirements. EURC includes Solana; cirBTC does not. Ordinary Ethereum/Base deposits show approximately 13-19 minutes to attestation; advertised fast access is not initial funding time.

supplemental.title: OFT Technical Reference
supplemental.relevance: Direct and adapter patterns, directional peers, shared/local decimals and dust, custom fees/rate limits/access controls. A common standard does not establish an arbitrary token's lossless, available or unrestricted exit.
supplemental.caveats: Documentation examples are not verified token decimals; no assumption that actual USDC uses generic example precision. Modern LayerZero v2 documentation is not proof of OmniCat's 2023 messaging endpoint/configuration.

supplemental.title: USDT0 Technical Documentation
supplemental.relevance: Provider describes Ethereum underlying lock/destination mint and burn/unlock redemption. IOTA Move has a dedicated Ethereum lockbox, not direct connectivity to every other USDT0 chain.
supplemental.caveats: Provider's 1:1 backing description is not proof of cash redemption eligibility, current reserves, mint permissions or live route availability. No legacy native-USDT variant is assumed freely interchangeable.

supplemental.title: USDT0 Goes Live on Stellar, Connecting Unified Dollar Liquidity to the World's Most Accessible Network
supplemental.relevance: Current-window non-EVM new destination deployment; release says USDT0 initially launched January 2025. Specific Stellar issuer/contract, permissions, tradable pools and net capture were not checked.
supplemental.caveats: Network foundation expressly does not guarantee backing/redemption and says aggregate figures are third-party and unverified. No aggregate volume or partner list is used as profitability evidence.

supplemental.title: Use EURC and cirBTC with Gateway
supplemental.relevance: Balances stay separate by asset; same-asset transfers only. EURC 6 decimals, cirBTC 8; authoritative estimate is transfer-specific. EURC issuance on Stellar/Cronos does not imply Gateway availability there; Solana nanopayments are not supported.
supplemental.safety: Direct ERC-20 sends to the Gateway Wallet lose funds; proper deposit methods and delayed withdrawal rules apply. No deposit or transfer was attempted.

supplemental.title: OmniCat Base contract explorer
supplemental.relevance: Explorer labels the project-linked Base address OmniCat and reports exact-match source verification, contract name OFTV2, compiler 0.8.19. This is corroborating identity, not runtime, peer, fee or tax verification.
supplemental.caveats: OFTV2 contract naming is not automatically LayerZero messaging protocol v2. No full code audit, historical state or archived receipts were fetched.

supplemental.title: Integrate Custom Token
supplemental.relevance: ITS equivalence is linked to interchainTokenId, per-chain managers, metadata/decimal scaling and manager type/permissions, not matching ticker or address alone. Source describes lock/unlock and mint/burn patterns.
supplemental.caveats: No particular ITS issuer or deployed token pair was verified. Source code/tutorial examples were read as documentation, never installed, deployed, signed or operationalized.
